items.markdown:
The Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care (CHC50121 or CHC50125) in Melbourne `takes about 12 to 18 months to complete, requires 280 hours of practical placement, and costs between $7,500 and $18,000` (though many domestic students can access it tuition-free through the Free TAFE initiative).[](https://www.mcie.edu.au/course/chc50121-diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/) [[1]](https://www.mcie.edu.au/course/chc50121-diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)[[2]](https://wmit.edu.au/course/international-students/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)[[3]](https://www.ames.net.au/study/vocational-courses/chc50125-diploma-early-childhood-education-and-care)[[4]](https://www.academia21.com/school/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)[[5]](https://allied.edu.au/courses/diploma-early-childhood-education-care)[[6]](https://www.vic.gov.au/you-can-shape-young-lives)

Top local TAFEs and institutions offering this course in and around Melbourne include:

- **[Box Hill Institute](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/)** : Offers flexible delivery for current sector workers (requires an existing Certificate III).
- **[Holmesglen Institute](https://www.holmesglen.edu.au/explore-courses/english-education-and-teacher-training/early-childhood-education/vocational-education/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)** : City and suburban campuses; builds skills for leadership roles like Room Leader or Service Director.
- **[Melbourne Polytechnic](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/diploma/early-childhood-education-and-care/non-traineeship/)** : Offers both traineeship and non-traineeship study modes with a mandatory 280-hour placement.
- **[MCIE](https://www.mcie.edu.au/course/chc50121-diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)** : A 52-week blended program. Metropolitan tuition fees are approx. $3,400 (with subsidy).
- **[Victoria University](https://www.vu.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-chc50125)** : Includes five specific work placements and a first-aid course.
- **[Academia International](https://www.academia21.com/school/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)** : Located on Lonsdale St in the Melbourne CBD, offering international student pathways (CRICOS).[[1]](https://www.academia21.com/school/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)[[2]](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/diploma/early-childhood-education-and-care/traineeship/)[[3]](https://www.mcie.edu.au/course/chc50121-diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)

**Important Considerations:** 

- **Free TAFE Eligibility:** If you are an Australian citizen, permanent resident, or New Zealand citizen, you may be eligible to study this diploma for free under the [Victorian Free TAFE program](https://www.vic.gov.au/you-can-shape-young-lives).[[1]](https://www.vic.gov.au/you-can-shape-young-lives)
- **Entry Requirements:** Most courses require you to have already completed the Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care and possess a current Working With Children Check (WWCC).[](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/) [[1]](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/)[[2]](https://www.accco.com.au/course/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)
